subject.title: fix: beta releases require manual reruns after plugin publication

question: Should beta releases publish the core package before plugin npm/ClawHub convergence completes, while treating packaged-upgrade evidence as advisory?
rationale: This is a deliberate change to the beta release guarantee and operator recovery model, not a mechanical implementation detail that review can safely decide alone.

options.title: Adopt detached beta convergence
options.body: After the two correctness repairs, keep core beta publication independent from plugin ecosystem convergence and document the resulting beta-live versus ecosystem-converged states.

options.title: Keep ecosystem convergence blocking
options.body: Require plugin npm, ClawHub, and packaged-upgrade success before a beta release is considered complete, preserving the previous operator contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt detached beta convergence
recommendation.body: After the two correctness repairs, keep core beta publication independent from plugin ecosystem convergence and document the resulting beta-live versus ecosystem-converged states.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history ties this person to the release-controller and beta recovery design under review.
